title: Course de Bois Sauvage (Wildwood kart race event)
names_seen: Course de Bois Sauvage (Wildwood kart race event)

facts.statement: Free Realms ran a fast kart racing event at the Bois Sauvage circuit, with Free Realms ambassadors inviting players to join.
facts.quote: Rejoignez les ambassadeurs de Free Realms pour un des plus rapides jeux dans Free Realms...Course de karts !

facts.statement: The Americas session was on Thursday 10 March 2011 at 3pm Pacific Time, on Server 1.
facts.quote: jeudi 10 mars 2011 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. et l'Amérique Latine) Serveur 1

facts.statement: The UK and Europe session was on Friday 11 March 2011 at 18:00 CET (4:00pm GMT), on Server 1.
facts.quote: vendredi 11 mars 2011 18:00am CET (Heure de paris)/ 4:00pm GMT (UK et l'Europe) Serveur 1

facts.statement: Players were told to wear a helmet for the race, and non-racers could join an off-track party beside the race.
facts.quote: nous allons faire la fête à l'extérieur de la course. Rendez-vous donc sur le circuit! N'oublie pas de Porter un casque.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A French-language official news/event notice announcing a kart race event at the Wildwood (French: Bois Sauvage) Speedway, held on two dates in March 2011 on Server 1 for different regions, hosted by Free Realms ambassadors. The page gives the race schedule and a helmet reminder; it says nothing about rewards or race rules. The date 2011-03-10 is inferred from the first event date given in the text; the page header itself shows only a relative 'posted 2 months, 3 weeks ago' age.
